The ground truth answer provided is "Jane Ballou." However, based on historical record, the 15th First Lady, Jane Pierce, was the wife of Franklin Pierce, the 14th president. The wife of the 15th president (James Buchanan) was none, as he was a bachelor. The 15th First Lady by White House order is sometimes considered to be Harriet Lane, his niece, but the typical list counts Jane Pierce.

Regardless, the predicted answer and the ground truth answer differ—one says "Abigail Ballou" and the other "Jane Ballou." The names "Abigail" and "Jane" are not the same, and thus, the ground truth answer "Jane Ballou" is not present in the predicted answer.
